mapper.sql: id, origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, category, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, create_time, status, download_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_info (origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, category, file_size, content_type, uploader_id, status) VALUES (#{originName}, #{storeName}, #{filePath}, #{ext}, #{category}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND status != 0 AND category = #{category} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE file_info SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file_info SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
